pages.text: A $(l)Pyre Torch$() sets alight whatever it strikes, burns corpses at a touch, and lights pyres.
Thrown, a $(l)Quicklime Bomb$() cleanses the Blight around it, dissolves the dead, kills flea and fly clouds and burns the plague's creatures.
A $(l)Fumigation Bomb$() leaves thirty seconds of herb smoke: a brazier you can throw.
